english.title: Allow a vehicle / an animal to be on Gatwick Airport after being forbidden to do so by a PC / airport official
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), allowed

(A)_[a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(B)_[an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMAL..),]_
(C)_[a thing, namely **(..SPECIFY THING..),]_

to be on Gatwick Airport - London after its presence had been forbidden by

(D)_[a constable]_
(E)_[an airport official]_

who had reasonable grounds to believe that its presence had been or was about to be responsible for a breach of a byelaw or for a criminal offence, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BYELAW OR OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 3(10) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
